# DevSearch

> Developer search across official documentation, GitHub and Stack Overflow, with AI answers whose every claim cites a retrieved source.

DevSearch is a private, sign-in-only application. There is no public content to index or train on, and the API is not open to third parties.

## Notes for agents

- All pages except /login require an authenticated session; automated access is not permitted.
- Answers are generated per request from crawled sources and are not stable reference material.
- Security reports: see /.well-known/security.txt
